fields.statement: Verifier at ca5773613 (attempt 2). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-env|daemon-settings-scope)$' passes: workflow-env.txtar runs a workflow with [env] FOO={run_tmp} and PLAIN=x, its command step sees FOO as an existing folder and PLAIN=x and no GOTMPDIR, the folder is gone after the run, and a workflow without [env] sees neither GOTMPDIR nor FOO. No non-test Go code under internal/ or cmd/ sets GOTMPDIR. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ./internal/run/... pass. The fix commit adds TestSessionRunWorkflowEnv (session.run gives an agent a run's [env]: {run_tmp}/go with the folder made, and a plain value) and an env key to FileKeys and docs/reference/workflow-file.md; go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestSession passes in a scratch worktree outside ~/code (under ~/code the rootguard reports usage.live.json, which the live Claude Code statusline rewrites every second, not this change). A built rhiza's workflow check accepts every .rhiza/workflows/*.toml, bugfix.toml and plan-bug.toml included.
